name: @intellectual-frontiers/system
description: The host system as one typed library: files, paths, the folders of a program, one run at a time, file watching, programs found by prefix, processes and their streams, Git, a program built into one binary, the operating system's scheduled jobs, and the terminal's streams; the same code on Bun and Node 26.
